newsitem.title: CHINA: Respect HK people,top Chinese general tells troops.
newsitem.headline: Respect HK people,top Chinese general tells troops.

text.p: China's top army official on Monday told People's Liberation Army troops, who will enter Hong Kong to assert Chinese sovereignty, to love the people of the territory and protect their prosperity.

"You must love the people of Hong Kong... and with your actual deeds win the support and love of the Hong Kong people," General Liu Huaqing, vice-chairman of the Central Military Commission, told the troops just hours before they sweep into Hong Kong.

Liu spoke at a departure ceremony at a barracks in the southern border city of Shenzhen for several thousand troops who will form the garrison stationed in Hong Kong. He reminded them that Hong Kong would enjoy autonomy under late paramount leader Deng Xiaoping's "one country, two systems" formula.
"I hope that you can bring justice into full play to resist all kinds of evil winds and noxious influences," Liu said.
"We must ensure that our troops can withstand the tests of special circumstances and complicated situations," he said.

The first 509 soldiers are due to march into Hong Kong at 9.00 p.m. (1300 GMT) while a further 4,000 soldiers, backed by patrol boats, armoured personnel carriers and helicopters, will stream into the territory six hours after the handover ceremony at midnight on Monday.
